name: @titanforge/language-service
description: Real, working code intelligence backed by TypeScript's own compiler-provided ts.LanguageService (the same engine behind VS Code / the TS Playground), driven by a ts.LanguageServiceHost that reads and version-tracks files through @titanforge/vfs. Honest scope note: this is TypeScript's real language service, not a from-scratch LSP, and not WASM-cross-compiled — see README/index.ts comments for why that substitution was made for the 'compiled to WASM' part of the brief.
